description: Returns the authenticated homeowner profile as structured JSON. Fields include status, name, phone, address, search_location, error_code, and message. Status values are "ok", "error", and "auth_required". search_location is a 5-digit ZIP from address.postalCode (e.g. "22307" or "94114").

context.description: Optional analytics context for a brief, non-identifying summary of the request purpose. The value is recorded as Agent Intent.
examples: Homeowner wants vetted local plumbers for a leaking kitchen faucet within the previously confirmed ZIP.
Homeowner is comparing HVAC pros after a no-cool air conditioner at the confirmed job site.

name: get_my_profile

HomeownerAddress.description: Structured service address returned from the homeowner profile.

formattedAddress.description: Single-line formatted address when available (output only)
formattedAddress.title: Formattedaddress

HomeownerAddress.title: HomeownerAddress

outputSchema.description: Authenticated homeowner profile returned by get_my_profile.

examples.message: Authentication is required for this request.

address.description: Full service street address on file with fields address1, address2, city, region, postalCode, country, formattedAddress

error_code.description: Stable code such as "AUTH_REQUIRED" when status is auth_required
error_code.title: Error Code

name.description: Homeowner full name from profile (present when status is ok)
name.title: Name

phone.title: Phone

status.title: Status
